g.title: note
g.text: Rounded boxes = processes; rectangles = external entities;
record boxes = logical data stores; arrows = named data flows.
Gym roles also use personal-user functions. All actions are authorized.
D1–D5 use Supabase services; D6 is bundled reference data;
D7 is browser/device state. Saved private device copies are cleared on sign-out.
Account resets/deletion affect the applicable stores (not all arrows shown).
Reminders run while the app is open; no closed-app push is implied.
Quiz scores and chat state are transient. Payments are recorded offline receipts.
